title: David Choe LOVES Being Gay | Joe Rogan | JRE 1965
summary: A 2:22 JRE 1965 excerpt with a clickbait title that is materially narrower than the transcript. An unresolved primary speaker jokes with friends about nearing sex with a man after threesomes/group sex, recalls parents in Mexico City using Andy Warhol and Leonardo da Vinci anecdotes to invite him to come out, then says he loves “being gay” while immediately clarifying he is not gay and almost wishes he were. He prefers gay male roles/avatars in games, acting and online contexts but says he does not desire penises; he links the wish to shame becoming shameless and liking pain. He then describes proximity to a transgender woman and contemplating—but not performing—genital contact, before describing boredom with the broader sexual endeavor. Every idea remains. The archive does not declare his orientation, identify the private woman, verify family/art-history claims, or infer consent, contact, kink, diagnosis, trauma or self-harm.
